# How to do the task

This guide is for a reader who knows the basics of logex. Say the goal in 1 sentence.

Copy this file to `guides/howto/`, give it a name that is the task and add its line to
`docs/pages.exs`. Then replace each paragraph with the text of the guide.

## Before you start

- Say what the reader must have and must know.
- Link to the tutorial or the reference page that gives it.

## Steps

1. Give 1 action in each step, as a command.
2. Show the result of the step straight after it.
3. Do not teach and do not explain. Link to the reference for the rules.

## The result

Say what the reader has when the steps are complete. Show the output.

## If it does not work

| What you see | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Quote the message in a code span | Give the cause in a few words | Give the action as a command |

## See also

- Link to the reference page that has the rules.
- Link to the explanation page that has the reasons.
